post.title: ACH vs wire vs instant: why the same $1,000 costs $0 or $30
post.ig:
Same $1,000: one transfer's free, another costs $30.

ACH moved 35.2 billion payments in 2025 (Nacha); standard transfers usually take 1-2 business days.
Bank of America lists $30 for an outgoing domestic wire (fee schedule effective Aug 2026); wires run on business days.
RTP (since 2017) and FedNow (since July 2023) settle in seconds, 24/7, with network limits up to $10M per payment.
Example: Venmo instant cash-out is 1.75% (min $0.25, max $25): $17.50 on $1,000. Standard is free, 1-3 business days.

Sources: Nacha; Federal Reserve; The Clearing House; Bank of America; Venmo.
